gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 10 build step remains the narrowest honest place to keep the landed MMIO helper, the dedicated `phase10-virtio-mmio-lab-tests` replay route, the wrapper-facing verify replay, and the dedicated survey replay reviewable together.
The existing virtio core lab slice already keeps shared status and queue bookkeeping explicit, so the MMIO lane can stay focused on transport-local wrappers and validation.

Current master already carries the in-memory VirtioMmioLab helper surface for bounded transport identity, queue readiness, interrupt-ack disposition, feature negotiation, config-write plan freshness, config-write planning, config-write apply observation, and config-write disposition.
The helper exposes a transport identity summary that keeps magic, version, device, and vendor checks reviewable without claiming live transport execution.
The probe-preflight summary keeps queue-window, interrupt-ack, and legacy guest-page-size readiness explicit below probe handoff.
The selected-queue readiness summary keeps queue-size programming and queue-ready gating reviewable entirely in memory.
The interrupt-ack disposition summary keeps pending, acknowledged, ignored, and remaining bits explicit without claiming live IRQ delivery parity.
The feature-negotiation summary keeps shared, device-only, and driver-only bits explicit without claiming live negotiation against hardware.
The config-write plan freshness summary keeps staged-plan availability and generation-rollover invalidation explicit without widening into config application.
The config-write disposition summary records byte-level staged deltas while keeping the MMIO config window unchanged.
The config-write apply-observation summary keeps touched-byte coverage, changed-byte counts, and no-op planning explicit while leaving the staged MMIO config window unchanged.

The dedicated `zigux/tests/phase10_virtio_mmio_apply_observation_replay.zig` replay and its standalone build shard keep changed-byte coverage, stale-plan rejection, and no-op planning reviewable beside the broader MMIO lab, verify, and survey gates without widening into transport-backed execution.

The wrapper-facing verify replay keeps probe, queue-readiness, interrupt-ack, feature-negotiation drift, config-write freshness, config-write apply observation, and config-byte-count checks explicit beside the helper.

The dedicated MMIO replay stays visible through the shared `phase10-virtio-mmio-lab-tests` route and keeps probe gating, queue readiness, interrupt-ack disposition, feature negotiation, config-write plan freshness, and config-write disposition reviewable as VM-friendly lab validation.

The dedicated survey replay stays visible through the shared `phase10-virtio-mmio-survey-tests` route and rereads the MMIO survey note beside the shared build gate without widening into transport-backed lifecycle claims.
The survey note keeps the landed MMIO helper packet explicit and bounded to wrapper-first lab evidence.
The companion note keeps the byte-level config-write disposition rung explicit beside the broader MMIO survey.
The slice companion now materializes on current master and keeps the helper-local MMIO packet reviewable beside the survey note, config-write companion, manifest, and checker.
Transport-backed queue setup, IRQ delivery, DMA handoff, and probe/remove or freeze/restore lifecycle behavior remain intentionally blocked behind the Phase 10 risky-transport boundary.
